turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so you have twenty minutes. Who decided Owen gets a zero, and why did he find out on his phone in the middle of class?
Thanks for coming in. I want to walk through the version history.
Fine, turn the screen so I can read it myself. You still haven't told me who decided on the zero, Hale.
612 words in one edit at 11:52 PM, then 794 more at 11:58 PM.
And none of that changes that the zero went in before anyone called me, which breaks your own procedure 4.2.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me, and that nothing about this is placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on Owen's record; the fair outcome would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and the meeting ended before Hale got anywhere near it.
What moved her: Nothing moved her position, though the version history with exact edit times was the strongest thing Hale had because it was specific and tied to Owen's own work, and it got her asking to see the screen.
What cost ground: Hale never answered who decided on the zero or owned entering it before calling home, so she had a procedural failure to hide behind the moment the evidence got uncomfortable.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; the late-night edit times Hale read out came close to that kind of night, which is why she went short and straight to procedure instead of questioning the times; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Before mentioning the version history, spend one sentence owning that the zero went into the gradebook before you called her, then give the date of those late-night edits and let her read the screen herself.
Redo the debrief as a table please.
